Prompts sent to the model

The instruction part only — the specification, code and transcript are appended automatically. Leave a box empty to use the built-in text.

Labels line ranges of the session: prose, spec, plan, code, output.

Semantic review

Finds what regexes cannot: what a test really checks, coverage, fragility, missing cases.

Verification

Keeps only findings the model can quote verbatim from the materials.

Semantic review — local model

Used for a local provider: one request per file, shorter and with an example.

Compress rules.md

Turns the proposed CLAUDE.md rules into one short numbered policy with ❌/✅ examples.

Generate skill

sidebar/settings:
Models

The key is stored only in this browser and sent directly to the chosen provider's API. Requests run on your account.

No models configured yet — add one below.
Add a model

Uses your Claude plan through the Claude Code you already have installed. No API key. A review sends several requests, and all of them count against your plan's usage limits.

Claude Code command

The path is the setting “sessionlens.claudeCliPath”; empty means “claude” is found automatically. Sign in once in a terminal with “claude auth login”.
Model per request

Choose which of your configured models answers each kind of request. Add models above first — this list only offers to pick among them.

SegmentationLabels line ranges of the session: prose, spec, plan, code, output.
Semantic reviewFinds what regexes cannot: what a test really checks, coverage, fragility, missing cases.
VerificationKeeps only findings the model can quote verbatim from the materials.
Compress rules.mdTurns the proposed {f} rules into one short numbered policy with ❌/✅ examples.
Generate skillTurns confirmed rules into a full Agent Skill package (SKILL.md + patterns/antipatterns + optional check script).

Findings format

Open schema: {check, severity, seq, message, evidence?, source, verdict?}. External findings (another tool, Code Review) are imported in the Calibration tab as a JSON array with a session field and take part in calibration as source: "external".

Applies at once. A demo session you already opened stays in the Sessions list until you delete it; turn this off to get the button back.

Shows the exact prompt sent to the model and its raw reply — in a session (below Transcript) and on the Calibration tab. Off by default. Turn it on only when you need to check what the model was actually asked and answered; the prompts include the session code and transcript excerpts that were sent.

Reset settings

Puts every setting on this page back to its default: theme, all configured models and their keys, the model per request, the local server and Qwen addresses, request pacing, code limit, ESLint, verification, the debug model toggle and the Hide the “Try a demo session” button checkbox. Your sessions, verdicts, rules and prompts are not touched, nor are the Claude Code, Codex and Cursor CLI paths (editor settings).

Danger zone

Deletes every session and all calibration history (confirmed findings, "moved" marks, hidden rules). Settings and rule wording in the Rules tab are kept.
